paite: Huchi in Israel tengteng Hebron ah David kiang ah ahong kikhawm ua, "Ngai in, na guh leh na sa ka hi uh.
heading: Judah Leh Israel Kumpipa David / (2 Sam 5.1-10)

paite: Tuma lam in, Saul mahmah kumpipa ahih lai in, Israel pikhia a pilut nang na hi a; TOUPA na Pathian in na kiang ah, Israel ka mite na vak ding a, ka mite Israel tung ah lal na hi ding hi, hon chi,” achi uhi.

Huchi in Israel Upa tengteng Hebron ah kumpipa kiang ah ahong pai ua; huan David in Hebron ah TOUPA ma ah amau toh thukhun abawlpih a; Samuel khut a TOUPA thu bang in, Israel tung a kumpipa ding in David thau anilh uhi.
David leh Israel tengteng Jerusalem, huai tuh Jebus ahi a, huai ah ahoh ua; huchi in Jebus mite, huai gam a tengte huai ah a-om uhi.
Huchi in Jebus a tengte'n David kiang ah, "Hiai lam a na hong louh ding ahi," achi ua. Himahleh David in Zion kulh muanhuai ala a; huai mah David khopi ahi.
David in, "Kuapeuh Jebus mite that masa penpen alianpen leh heutu ahi ding," achi a. Huan Zeruiah tapa Joab akuantou masapen a, huchi in amah alianpen a bawl in a-omta hi.
David bel kulh muanhuai ah ateng a; huaiziak in David khopi achi uhi.
Huchi in khopi abawlsuak vek a, Millo kimvel a kipan nangawn in: huchi in Joab in khopi dangte abawlhoih vek hi.
Akiang a sepaihte' TOUPA a-om ziak in, David ahong thupi semsem hi.
Hiaite David neih mihatte lak a amakaipente ahi uh, Israel tungtang a TOUPA thu bang zel a, amah kumpipa dia bawl ding a, Israel tengteng toh, agamsung a amah lak a ahatna uh taklangte.
heading: David Sepaih Minthangte

paite: Hiai David in aneih mihatte zah ahi: Jashobeam, Hakmon mi tapa, sawmthumte lak a makai lianpen; zathumte dou ding in ateipi alek a khatvei thu in amaute athat hi.
Amah nung in Dodo tapa Eleazar, Ahoh mi, mihat thumte lak a khat ahi hi.
Pasdammim ah David kiang ah a-om a, huai ah kidou tum in Philistia mite akikhawm ua, barli buh a dimna mun ah; Philistia mite ma a kipan in mite ataikekta uhi.
Huchi in huai mun laitak ah adingh ua, ahum ua, Philistia mite athat uhi; TOUPA'N zohna thupitak in amaute ahondamta hi.
Heutu lian sawmthumte lak a thum suangpi a David kiang ah, Adullam kokhuk ah ahohsuk uhi; Philistia mite tampite'n Rephaim Phaizang ah puanin akai uhi.
Huai lai in David bel kohawm sung ah a-om a, Philistia mite kulhpi bel Bethlehem ah a-om hi.
Huchi in David in tui alunggulh a, "Aw kongpi kiang a om, Bethlehem tuileh tui dawn ding a hong pia mi khat omleh chi na ing e!" achi hi.

Huai thumte'n Philistia mite tampi lak aphu paisuak ua, kongpi kiang a om, Bethlehem tuileh a kipan tui ava tawi ua, ahon la ua, David kiang ahon tun uhi: himahleh David in adawn nuam kei a, TOUPA a ding in abungkhe zaw hi.

Hiai ka hih, ka Pathian in hon phal kei hen: ahinna uh lauhuaina a koih hiai mite sisan ka dawn ding hia? Amaute'n lah ahinna uh lauthawnna toh hon tawi uh ahi ngal ua,” achi hi. Huaiziak in adawn nuamta kei hi. Hiai thilte huai mihat thumte'n ahih uh ahi.
Abishai, Joab unaupa, huai thumte lak a khat ahi: ama'n zathumte dou ding in ateipi alik a amaute athat a, mi thumte lak ah min aneita hi.
Thumte lak ah, nihte sang in, amah azahtakhuai zaw hi, huchi in aheutupa ding ua bawl in a-om hi: hita mahleh thum masate zaw apha kei.
Jehoiada tapa Benaiah, Kabzeel a mihangsan, thilhih thupite hihpa tapa, Moab a Ariel tapate nihte athat a: apaisuk lai a, vuk kiak lai in kokhuk lak ah humpinelkai athat hi.

Aigupta mi athat a, milian mahmah, tong nga a sang; huan Aigupta mi khut a ateipi siamganmi chiam bang ahi; huchi in akiang ah chiangkhun toh ahohsuk a, Aigupta mi khut a kipan teipi ala a, amah mah teipi in ahihlumta hi.
Hiai thilte Jehoiada tapa Benaiah in ahih a, huchi in huai mihat thumte lak ah min anei hi.
Ngai in, sawmthumte sang in zahtakhuaizaw in a-om a, himahleh thum masate zaw apha kei, huchi in David in agalvil heutu in amah akoih hi.
Sepaih pawlte a mihatte: Joab unaupa Asahel, Bethlehem a Dodo tapa Elhanan;
Haror mi Shammoth, Pelon mi Helez;
Tekoa mi Ikkesh tapa Ira, Antoth mi Abiezer.
Husat mi Sibbekai, Ahoh mi Ilai;
Netophah mi Maharai, Netophah mi Baanah tapa Heled;
Benjamin tate Gibeah a Ribai tapa Ithai, Pirathon mi Benaiah;
Gaash luitate a Hurai, Arbath mi Abiel.
Baharum mi Azmaveth, Saalbon mi Eliahba;
Gizon mi Hasem tapate, Harar mi Shage tapa Jonathan;
Harar mi Sakar tapa Ahiam, Ur tapa Eliphal;
Mekerath mi Hepher, Pelon mi Ahijah;
Karmel mi Hezro, Ezbai tapa Naarai;
Nahtan unaupa Joel, Hageri tapa Mibhar.
Ammon mi Zelek, Beroth mi Naharai, Joab galvan pomi Zeruiah tapa;
Ithri mi Ira, Ithri mi Gareb;
Hit mi Uriah, Ahlai tapa Zabad;
Reuben mi Shiza tapa Adina, Reuben mite lak a makai lianpen leh akiang a sawmthumte.
Maakah tapa Hanan, Mithni mi Josaphat;
Asterath mi Uzzia, Aroer mi Hotham tapate Shama leh Jehiel,
Shimri tapa Jediael, Tiz mi a-unaupa Joha;
Mahavi mi Eliel leh Jeribai, leh Elnaam tapate Joshaviah, Moab mi Ithmah;
Eliel, Obed leh Mezoba mi Jaasiel ahi uh.
